AbstractText.Label: BACKGROUND
AbstractText.content: Obesity is a pathological state caused by abnormal or excessive accumulation of fat. Swietenia mahogani JACQ., known as West Indian mahogany, is a medium-sized semi-evergreen tree belonging to Meliaceae. Their seeds are used in Indonesian folk medicine as a treatment for hypertension, diabetes, malaria, and it also has anti-feedant activities. The major components of S. mahogani are B, D-seco limonoids, a type of irregular triterpenes are well known.

AbstractText.Label: OBJECTIVE
AbstractText.content: We tried to find the bioactive components, which have the inhibitory activity on adipocyte differentiation from the seeds of S. mahogani.

AbstractText.Label: MATERIAL AND METHODS
AbstractText.content: 3T3-L1 cells, derived from mouse preadipocyte, are widely used in studying adipogenesis process. In this study, we used 3T3-L1 cells to find natural products with the inhibitory activity on adipocyte differentiation. S. mahogani seeds were dried and extracted with 100% MeOH.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: The methanolic extract was fractionated by bioassay-guided method to give nine B, D-seco limonoids (1-9) with slight structural modifications. Among nine compounds, compounds 4, 6 and 8 exhibited significant inhibitory effects of cell differentiation on 3T3-L1 cells. Those compounds have tigloyl residue at C-3 in common. Besides, compounds with no tigloyl residue at C-3 showed insignificant effect. Nevertheless, not all compounds with tigloyl residue at C-3 exerted significant inhibitory effect.

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSION
AbstractText.content: These results suggested that tigloyl residue at C-3 may play a role in the anti-proliferative activity on a dipogenesis and the refined extract of S. mahogani may have a potential to be developed as a therapeutic agent to treat obesity.

AbstractText.Label: SUMMARY
AbstractText.content: Nine irregular seco-limonoids were isolated from Swietenia mahogani.Total extract and CHCl3 fraction of S. mahogani showed the significant inhibitory activities on 3T3-L1 cell differentiation.A tigloyl residue at C-3 in an aglycone may play a role in the anti-proliferative activity on adipogenesis.
